title: Return to the Sunken Archive
summary: Reach the sealed structure discovered during the previous expedition and determine whether an entrance can be established.
objective: Open or bypass the sealed door in the Central Row.
briefing:
Read [[the-first-descent]] before signing on. The door's inscriptions may relate to [[the-karthian-flood-myth]].

- Bring light that does not depend on time passing
- Expect disorientation
